title: U.S. House · Texas's 12th District
area: Fort Worth and surrounding Tarrant County.

context.text: Incumbent Republican Craig Goldman won his primary unopposed. Heli Rodriguez Prilliman defeated Kenneth Morgan-Aguilera in the Democratic primary, 59.8%-40.2%.

candidates.name: Craig Goldman
candidates.ballotNote: Won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary unopposed

summary.text: Craig Goldman is the Republican incumbent seeking re-election in Texas's 12th District. A former Fort Worth businessman and Texas state representative, he serves on the House Energy and Commerce Committee and has sponsored bipartisan legislation with Fort Worth-area Democratic Rep. Marc Veasey.

background.text: Born in Texas and lives in Fort Worth; earned a B.A. from the University of Texas at Austin.
Career experience includes running a retail gourmet food and fine wine store in Fort Worth, working on political campaigns, and being a partner in several real estate investment companies.

positions.summary: Introduced the Better Care, Better Cost Act, which he says would use market-based incentives to strengthen Medicaid.

record.text: Serves on the Committee on Energy and Commerce, including its Subcommittees on Commerce, Manufacturing, and Trade, Communications and Technology, and Energy, for the 119th Congress (2025-2026).
Introduced the Kay Granger Post Office Act with Democratic Rep. Marc Veasey to name a Fort Worth post office after former Rep. Kay Granger.
Co-introduced the Stop EU Overreach Act with Reps. Jodey Arrington and Greg Steube, aimed at countering European Union corporate-sustainability regulations affecting American businesses.
Co-introduced a bipartisan Prior Authorization Transparency bill with Reps. August Pfluger, Rob Wittman, Jimmy Panetta, Donald Norcross and Kim Schrier.
Introduced the Better Care, Better Cost Act to implement market-based incentives intended to strengthen Medicaid.

candidates.name: Heli Rodriguez Prilliman
candidates.ballotNote: Won the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary, 59.8%-40.2%, over Kenneth Morgan-Aguilera

summary.text: Angela 'Heli' Rodriguez Prilliman is the Democratic nominee challenging incumbent Craig Goldman in Texas's 12th District. A Fort Worth entrepreneur and educator with a decade of experience in technology, she is campaigning on universal healthcare, universal child care and fully funding public schools.

background.text: Raised in Stephenville, Texas, and a graduate of Texas A&M University.
Entrepreneur and educator with more than a decade of experience in the technology sector.

priorities.text: Fully funding public schools and removing what she describes as billionaire money from politics.

positions.summary: Campaigns on fighting for universal health care, citing Texas's high rate of uninsured residents.
Lists universal child care among her core campaign issues.
